paraphrase: Hartle and Hawking propose a ground-state wave function for spatially closed universes using a sum over compact Euclidean four-geometries, describing an interpretation from zero three-geometry. The proposal uses an action, quantum formalism and specified class of geometries. No-boundary in the Euclidean regime is not a proved absence of explanatory grounding; the paper is not attributed a metaphysical brute-fact thesis.
